data.one_liner: Detect shake gestures in Flutter apps on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget and imperative API to detect shake gestures on Android and iOS devices. It allows executing callbacks when a shake gesture is performed, and works on simulators as well.
use_when: You want to trigger a feature or debug menu via a shake gesture on mobile devices.
You need a drop-in widget or imperative callback for shake detection.
avoid_when: You need custom shake sensitivity specifically on iOS devices.
You are building for desktop or web platforms.
strengths: Supports both widget and imperative usage.
Works on iOS and Android simulators.
Includes test helpers for testing shake detection.
weaknesses: Shake gestures cannot be customized on iOS.
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
data.setup_notes: Optional customization can be done via AndroidManifest.xml for Android shake force and count.
